text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "In order to further improve the safety mindset in Swiss aviation, the FOCA has implemented new instruments such as safety management systems.", "gist": "FOCA implemented safety management systems to improve aviation safety in Switzerland."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Such systems enable companies to assess their own safety and take measures as needed.", "gist": "Safety management systems allow companies to evaluate and address their own safety issues."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "FOCA", "gist": "Federal Office for Civil Aviation"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Germany", "gist": "Country involved in flight path discussions"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Zurich Airport", "gist": "Airport in Switzerland"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Single European Sky project", "gist": "European initiative for uniform air traffic control"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The FOCA represents Switzerland in discussions with Germany regarding flight paths on the approach to Zurich Airport.", "gist": "FOCA represents Switzerland in negotiations with Germany about Zurich Airport flight paths."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The FOCA is also actively involved in the Single European Sky project, which seeks to establish a uniform air traffic control system in Europe.", "gist": "FOCA actively participates in the Single European Sky project for unified European air traffic control."}]}
